original_title: Introduction: Inventing Traditions
container: The Invention of Tradition, edited by Eric Hobsbawm and Terence Ranger (Cambridge University Press, 1983), pp. 1–14.
note: Hobsbawm’s introductory chapter; w-1105862 is the containing edited book, not this chapter. DOI identifies the chapter in a later edition.

original_title: Colony to Nation: A History of Canada
note: Arthur R. M. Lower’s 1946 book; the only candidate is a different article.

original_title: Canadian Women: A History
note: Collectively authored by Alison Prentice, Paula Bourne, Gail Cuthbert Brandt, Beth Light, Wendy Mitchinson and Naomi Black; absent from the candidates.

original_title: The History of Jamaica; or, General Survey of the Antient and Modern State of That Island
note: Edward Long’s three-volume work, London: T. Lowndes, 1774. No candidates supplied.

original_title: The English Atlantic, 1675–1740: An Exploration of Communication and Community
note: Ian K. Steele’s Oxford University Press book; none of the candidate articles is this work.

original_title: Uncle Sam Wants You: World War I and the Making of the Modern American Citizen
note: Christopher Capozzola’s 2008 Oxford University Press book. No candidates supplied.

original_title: An Intimate History of Killing: Face-to-Face Killing in Twentieth-Century Warfare
note: First published by Granta in 1999; absent from the candidates. Dismembering the Male is a different book.

original_title: Manual de história oral
note: Meihy’s Loyola manual, first published in 1996; the cited 2005 fifth edition retains this ISBN. Distinct from (Re)introduzindo a história oral no Brasil.

original_title: L’allégorie du patrimoine
note: Portuguese translation of Françoise Choay’s 1992 Seuil book. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Combats pour l’histoire
note: The catalogue identifies the 1989 Portuguese edition as a translation of Combats pour l’histoire.

original_title: Sécurité, territoire, population: cours au Collège de France, 1977–1978
note: Portuguese translation of the 2004 French publication of the 1977–1978 lectures; prefer the French original to w-632.

original_title: Pratiques de la lecture
note: Chartier’s institutional bibliography explicitly identifies Práticas da leitura (1996) as the Portuguese translation of this edited book.

original_title: Islands of History
note: Portuguese translation of Sahlins’s 1985 Chicago book. The candidate Other Times, Other Customs is one constituent essay, not the whole book.

original_title: A Dictionary of the English Language
note: By Samuel Johnson (1709–1784), the English lexicographer. The candidate author of The History of the Yorubas is a different Samuel Johnson.

original_title: Histoire de la sexualité, I: La volonté de savoir
note: An Introduction is Robert Hurley’s English title for La volonté de savoir, volume I. Match the French Histoire de la sexualité record; 1990 is a later English edition.

original_title: Qu’est-ce qu’un auteur ?
container: Bulletin de la Société française de philosophie, 63e année, no. 3 (July–September 1969), pp. 73–104.
note: Lecture delivered on 22 February 1969 and published in the Bulletin. Candidate collections contain versions of the essay but are not the essay itself.

original_title: História concisa do Brasil
note: The FUNAG catalogue identifies A Concise History of Brazil (1999) as the English edition of História concisa do Brasil. Portuguese publication followed in 2001; distinguish the longer História do Brasil (w-322677).

original_title: História militar do Brasil
note: Sodré’s book first appeared with Civilização Brasileira in 1965; 1979 is a later edition. None of the candidate books is this work.

original_title: De los medios a las mediaciones: comunicación, cultura y hegemonía
note: Portuguese translation of Martín-Barbero’s 1987 Spanish book. ISBN confirmed for the 1987 Gustavo Gili Mexican edition; no candidates supplied.

original_title: From Max Weber: Essays in Sociology
note: Portuguese translation of the selection edited and introduced by H. H. Gerth and C. Wright Mills. The catalogue gives From Max Weber as the uniform title; the same selection is in the graph.
